projection.description: The merchant sees the acquiring application form. Fields: company name, registration number, trading address, directors, estimated transaction volumes, average ticket size, industry/MCC category, current payment processor.
data_fields_visible: Estimated pricing range based on MCC and volume

actions_permitted: Upload supporting documents (business registration, director ID)
actions_not_permitted: Modify application after submission without bank approval

notifications.content: Your merchant acquiring application has been received. Reference: [ref]. We will review it within 5 working days.

projection.description: The merchant sees their PCI DSS compliance requirements based on estimated volume level. SAQ form or ROC upload interface is provided.

actions_not_permitted: Self-certify PCI DSS Level 1 compliance without QSA audit

notifications.content: Your PCI DSS compliance has been confirmed. Your application is progressing to approval.
You have been provisionally accepted. Please submit your SAQ/ROC by [date] to maintain your acquiring services.

projection.description: The merchant sees terminal delivery tracking, pricing summary (interchange++), settlement account details, and go-live confirmation.
data_fields_visible: Pricing plan detail (interchange, scheme fees, acquirer margin)

actions_not_permitted: Process live transactions before test transaction confirmation

notifications.content: Your payment terminal has been dispatched. Expected delivery: [date]. Tracking: [link].
Congratulations! Your merchant account is now live. You can start accepting card payments. Your reporting portal is at [url].

participants.participation_scope: Reviews and approves merchant applications. Reviews KYC outcomes for high-risk merchants. Manages scheme registration and terminal provisioning.

projection.description: Full view of merchant application, KYC screening results, sanctions outcomes, and UBO verification status.

actions_permitted: Approve or reject KYC for high-risk merchants

notifications.content: New merchant application [ref]. MCC: [code]. Estimated volume: [amount]/month.
Merchant [ref] KYC complete. Outcome: [CLEAR/REFERRAL]. Ready for credit assessment.

projection.description: Full credit assessment dashboard showing financial analysis, chargeback risk profile, and reserve recommendation.

actions_not_permitted: Waive chargeback reserve for high-risk MCC merchants

projection.description: Consolidated approval view with KYC, credit, and PCI DSS outcomes. Scheme registration status.

actions_not_permitted: Register merchant with scheme without completing all assessments

notifications.content: Merchant [ref] registered with Visa (MID: [mid]) and Mastercard (MID: [mid]).
